info.name: OmniStock Phase 4 - Catalog, Warehouses, Inventory & Transfers
info.description: Comprehensive Postman smoke test collection for OmniStock MVP Phase 4 (User Story 2: Accurate Inventory Tracking & Movements). Covers Categories, Products & Variants, Barcode Uniqueness, Warehouses & Allocation Priority, Inventory Adjustments & Stock Movement Ledger, Low-Stock Thresholds & Alerts Lifecycle, Inter-Warehouse Stock Transfers (DRAFT -> IN_TRANSIT -> RECEIVED / CANCELLED), and Cross-Tenant Isolation.
